subject: Clearbridge: subprocessor roster + evidence packet request
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@clearbridgetx.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@clearbridgetx.com
Date: Sat, 24 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: subprocessor roster + evidence pack for procurement review

Hi David,

Clearbridge's procurement and security teams are kicking off the vendor onboarding checklist and we need a consolidated evidence packet to close our SIG/CAR review. Can you please provide the following by EOD Wednesday (10/27)?

- Full subprocessor roster (CSV): names, function, country of processing, data access level.
- Current SOC 2 Type II report (redacted is fine) or link to the report and assertion date.
- CAIQ/SIG responses (spreadsheet or DOCX) mapped to your runtime and KMS controls.
- Short note on KMS ownership and key residency (do you use customer-managed keys / BYOK for Private deployments?).
- Any subprocessors that process or transit EU or APAC customer data specifically called out.

We'd also like to confirm whether you have any onshore-only processing options and if an SLA exception will be needed for our health-data use case.

I'm attaching our standard procurement evidence template (procurement_evidence_template.docx) to make sure we include the right artifacts.

If you need more time, please propose an alternate date.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Security Programs
Clearbridge Therapeutics

Attachment: procurement_evidence_template.docx (docx)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Marissa / Karthik —

FYI from Clearbridge. Can you pull the latest subprocessor roster and the redacted SOC2? Also need a short KMS note we can send (they care about BYOK / residency).

Plan: Marissa, can you assemble the CSV + SIG-lite mapping and upload to the evidence Drive folder? I can review and send to Elena by lunch.

Thanks,
David

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 24 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: subprocessor roster + evidence pack for procurement review

David / Karthik —

Attached:
- subprocessor_roster_20261024.csv (CSV) — includes vendor name, service, region, processing location, access type.
- SOC2-TypeII-Redacted-2026.pdf (PDF) — redacted for third-party details; contains auditor assertion and control coverage.
- SIG-lite-responses-20261024.xlsx (XLSX) — mapped to our serving runtime and KMS controls with supporting references.

Quick answers:
- KMS: Hosted customers use Redwood-managed AWS KMS keys by default; for Dedicated & Private we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) via AWS KMS or Azure Key Vault. Key residency follows the region of the deployment; we can BYOK to an onshore key for Clearbridge if needed.
- EU/APAC subprocessors: We have a small set of monitoring/observability partners and a GPU-hardware provisioning partner that may have EU/APAC footprints. Those entries are flagged in the roster column "region_of_processing".
- SLA exceptions: If they need contractual onshore-only processing guarantees, that typically maps to a Private deployment + DPA amendment / addendum.

I've uploaded the files to the shared evidence folder and left a short README. Link below.

Marissa
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: subprocessor_roster_20261024.csv; SOC2-TypeII-Redacted-2026.pdf; SIG-lite-responses-20261024.xlsx

Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-example-evidence

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@clearbridgetx.com>, security@clearbridgetx.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 24 Oct 2026 12:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: subprocessor roster + evidence pack for procurement review

Elena —

Thanks for the clear list. Per Marissa's upload, attached are the immediate artifacts we've prepared for your review: the subprocessor roster CSV, a redacted SOC 2 Type II report, and a SIG-lite response workbook that calls out controls for the serving runtime, KV cache, and KMS interactions.

Key points summary (TL;DR):
- Subprocessors: see roster column "region_of_processing" for EU/APAC entries; no EU-only processors for core inference path (we use region-aware routing).
- KMS & keys: Redwood-managed KMS keys by default for Hosted. For Dedicated and Private we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) and on-prem HSM integrations. If you require an onshore-only key, we can provision BYOK in your region under a DPA addendum.
- SOC 2: redacted report attached; full assertion details and auditor contact info are in the report.
- Next steps: If Clearbridge needs a CAIQ-to-control mapping (full CAIQ export), we can provide it but will need 2 business days to run the export and validate references.

Links & artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-example-evidence
DocuSign (DPA amendment draft): https://app.docusign.com/link/to/DPA-amendment-12345

If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-minute tech deep-dive with Karthik to walk through encryption and residency options. Proposed windows: Mon or Tue morning PST.

Thanks,
David Kim
Head of Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

Attachments: subprocessor_roster_20261024.csv; SOC2-TypeII-Redacted-2026.pdf; SIG-lite-responses-20261024.xlsx

From: Elena Rossi <elena@clearbridgetx.com>

David —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the package. We reviewed the roster and the flags you added for EU/APAC subprocessors; that helps. A couple quick clarifying items:

1) For BYOK in a Private deployment, can you confirm whether Redwood will accept an external HSM attestation (customer-provided) or whether Redwood only binds to cloud-provider KMS (we're considering on-prem HSM).
2) For the SIG-lite workbook, could you add a short reference cell pointing to specific SOC 2 control IDs where applicable (helps our mapping).

We can take the DPA amendment link to legal. Please pencil us in for a 30-min walkthrough on Monday 10/26 at 09:30 PT — Karthik's expertise will be useful.

Thanks again — we'll loop procurement/legal once we confirm the HSM/BYOK note.
